title: PCR Preparation with 384-Well Plate and Temperature Module
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set the following parameters before running the protocol: use up to four KingFisher 96‑well plates as inputs; enable the Opentrons Temperature Module to keep reagents cool (unless the *Only Transfer Samples* option is selected, which skips reagent transfers and the temperature module); specify the number of samples for each plate (Plate 1‑4, 0‑96 samples each, set to 0 to skip a plate); choose the pipette mount for the P20 Multi‑Channel GEN2 pipette; select the used‑tip drop location (empty tip rack recommended); and enable the *Only Transfer Samples* flag if only sample transfer is desired.

steps.title: Transfer water to 384‑well plate
steps.instruction: Using a column of tips, dispense 8.5 µL of water into every well of the 384‑well plate, then discard the tips.

steps.title: Transfer primer/probe mix
steps.instruction: Using a fresh column of tips, dispense 1.5 µL of primer/probe mix into every well of the 384‑well plate, then discard the tips.

steps.title: Transfer master mix
steps.instruction: Using a fresh column of tips, dispense 5 µL of master mix into every well of the 384‑well plate, then discard the tips.

steps.title: Process Plate 1 samples
steps.instruction: For each column of samples in Plate 1, pick up a column of tips, mix the sample, transfer it to the designated wells (Rows A, C, E…; Columns 1‑12) of the 384‑well plate, mix in the destination well, and dispose of the tips in the waste bin.

substeps.instruction: Pick up tips for the column.
Mix the sample.
Transfer to the appropriate 384‑well destination (Rows A/C/E…, Columns 1‑12).
Mix in the destination well.
Dispose tips in the waste bin.

steps.title: Process Plate 2 samples
steps.instruction: For each column of samples in Plate 2, pick up a column of tips, mix the sample, transfer it to the designated wells (Rows A, C, E…; Columns 13‑24) of the 384‑well plate, mix in the destination well, and dispose of the tips in the empty tip slots previously used for Plate 1.

substeps.instruction: Pick up tips for the column.
Mix the sample.
Transfer to the appropriate 384‑well destination (Rows A/C/E…, Columns 13‑24).
Mix in the destination well.
Dispose tips in the empty tip slots used for Plate 1.

steps.title: Process Plate 3 samples
steps.instruction: For each column of samples in Plate 3, pick up a column of tips, mix the sample, transfer it to the designated wells (Rows B, D, F…; Columns 1‑12) of the 384‑well plate, mix in the destination well, and dispose of the tips in the empty tip slots previously used for Plate 2.

substeps.instruction: Pick up tips for the column.
Mix the sample.
Transfer to the appropriate 384‑well destination (Rows B/D/F…, Columns 1‑12).
Mix in the destination well.
Dispose tips in the empty tip slots used for Plate 2.

steps.title: Process Plate 4 samples
steps.instruction: For each column of samples in Plate 4, pick up a column of tips, mix the sample, transfer it to the designated wells (Rows B, D, F…; Columns 13‑24) of the 384‑well plate, mix in the destination well, and dispose of the tips in the empty tip slots previously used for Plate 3.

substeps.instruction: Pick up tips for the column.
Mix the sample.
Transfer to the appropriate 384‑well destination (Rows B/D/F…, Columns 13‑24).
Mix in the destination well.
Dispose tips in the empty tip slots used for Plate 3.

steps.title: Finish protocol
steps.instruction: All transfers and tip disposals are complete; the protocol ends.
